does_not_measure: execution-reachability. A module counted here is one an import path reaches from an entrypoint. It is NOT proof that anything runs: a module imported inside a CLI command counts as wired even when the code it exposes is never entered. An empty map means no module is unimportable -- it does not mean every subsystem executes.

modules.convergence_decision: cryptographic convergence receipts; runs once a campaign consumes them
modules.exploration_space: orthogonal hypothesis axes; runs once a campaign enumerates them
modules.crystallization: advisory crystallization policy; wire into managed campaign evidence flow before it can affect runtime search posture
modules.formal_claims: pure claim-certificate contract; wire into candidate readiness only after runtime trace refinement exists
modules.justification_graph: pure justification provenance contract; wire once retained verifier receipts feed promotion evidence
